name: Regenerate sprites at 128px
command:
cd ~/pixel-art-studio && source .venv/bin/activate && \
python generate.py character -p "16-bit pixel art sprite, lone character, an armored knight with a glowing sword, front-facing battle stance, on a plain flat solid dark gray background" -o test/sprites/hero.png --downscale 4 --seed 11 && \
python generate.py character -p "16-bit pixel art sprite, lone character, a goblin bandit with tattered clothes and a small dagger, front-facing, on a plain flat solid dark gray background" -o test/sprites/grunt.png --downscale 4 --seed 21 && \
python generate.py character -p "16-bit pixel art sprite, lone character, a huge red demon brute with sharp claws and horns, front-facing, on a plain flat solid dark gray background" -o test/sprites/brute.png --downscale 4 --seed 31 && \
python generate.py character -p "16-bit pixel art sprite, lone character, a mossy stone golem with glowing amber eyes, front-facing, on a plain flat solid dark gray background" -o test/sprites/warden.png --downscale 4 --seed 41 && \
python generate.py character -p "16-bit pixel art sprite, lone creature, a giant venomous purple spider with eight legs and glowing eyes, front-facing, on a plain flat solid dark gray background" -o test/sprites/stinger.png --downscale 4 --seed 51
